description: This tilted bar chart illustrates Execution Accuracy across four categories for two different methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL. The chart's horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered sequentially as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Execution Accuracy", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 20 to 60 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10; notably, the axis baseline begins at 20 rather than zero. The chart features grouped bars, where each category contains two side-by-side bars. According to the legend positioned at the top, the light blue bars represent NatSQL and the dark blue bars represent TA-SQL. Every bar is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value at the top. In the "Simple" category, NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is the tallest bar overall at 63.14. For the "Moderate" category, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60. The "Challenging" category contains the shortest bars in the chart, with NatSQL at 32.32 and TA-SQL at 36.11. Finally, the "Total" category shows NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. The categories are ordered logically by difficulty followed by a total summary rather than being sorted by numerical value, and the entire chart is visually presented at a rotated angle.
